categories.name: Historical payment behaviour: the company as payer
Obligation payment regularity and pattern breaks
Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")

datapoints.name: Observed trading age
datapoints.definition: Months since the first approved invoice on either side, with a left-censored flag

datapoints.name: OP platform tenure
datapoints.definition: Months since the entity record was created

datapoints.name: Web domain
datapoints.definition: Company has its own web domain

datapoints.name: DJP taxpayer status
datapoints.definition: Latest DJP status: active vs NE, DE, not valid

datapoints.name: Coretax active status
datapoints.definition: Latest CTAS status: aktif vs non efektif

datapoints.name: VAT status (behavioural PKP)
datapoints.definition: pkp, VAT collector or non-pkp from filings and approved e-Faktur

datapoints.name: Name mismatch with DJP
datapoints.definition: OP entity name differs from the DJP-registered name

datapoints.name: Province
datapoints.definition: Normalised province, for regional peers and macro joins

datapoints.name: Observed sales value
datapoints.definition: Observed customers' purchases from the company plus own sales, deduped, 12m, log; a lower bound

datapoints.name: Purchase value
datapoints.definition: Approved purchases, 12m to the watermark, log

datapoints.name: Size grade
datapoints.definition: Large, medium, small, micro from max annualised sales, purchases or CIT revenue

datapoints.name: Employees (payroll)
datapoints.definition: Distinct employees on PPh 21 payroll

datapoints.name: Final UMKM tax regime
datapoints.definition: Pays PPh final UMKM, so turnover is under 4.8bn IDR

datapoints.name: Net VAT position
datapoints.definition: Output VAT minus input VAT over output VAT, 12m
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Tax type breadth
datapoints.definition: Distinct tax types paid or filed (PPN, PPh 21, 23, 25, 4(2))

datapoints.name: Active withholding agent
datapoints.definition: Issued e-Bupot slips in 24m

datapoints.name: OP application rejections
datapoints.definition: Rejected leads or drawdown applications, with reason

datapoints.name: OP credit-line utilisation
datapoints.definition: In-use amount over approved limit

datapoints.categoryName: Obligation payment regularity and pattern breaks
datapoints.name: Tax payment day dispersion
datapoints.definition: SD of the first payment day of the month across months

datapoints.categoryName: Obligation payment regularity and pattern breaks
datapoints.name: Payment-day adherence
datapoints.definition: Share of months within 3 days of the company's own median payment day

datapoints.categoryName: Obligation payment regularity and pattern breaks
datapoints.name: Weekday and week-of-month anchor
datapoints.definition: Share of months paid on the modal (weekday, week-of-month) pair ("Thursday of week 2")

datapoints.categoryName: Obligation payment regularity and pattern breaks
datapoints.name: Payment pattern-break flag
datapoints.definition: Regular payer whose latest month is more than 7 days off its own median, or a change point in 6 months

datapoints.categoryName: Obligation payment regularity and pattern breaks
datapoints.name: Break direction and size
datapoints.definition: Mean payment day after the latest break minus before

datapoints.categoryName: Obligation payment regularity and pattern breaks
datapoints.name: Filing-day dispersion
datapoints.definition: SD of the PPh 21 filing day across periods

datapoints.categoryName: Obligation payment regularity and pattern breaks
datapoints.name: Filing pattern-break flag
datapoints.definition: Regular filer that broke its pattern by more than 7 days in the last 6 periods

datapoints.categoryName: Obligation payment regularity and pattern breaks
datapoints.name: Early-payment buffer
datapoints.definition: Median days paid before the deadline

datapoints.name: SPT Masa on-time rate
datapoints.definition: Share of periods whose first e-filing approval is by the deadline, pooled tax types

datapoints.name: Filing lateness depth
datapoints.definition: p90 days filed after the deadline

datapoints.name: Late filings count
datapoints.definition: Late periodic returns in 24m

datapoints.name: SPT 1771 filed on time
datapoints.definition: Annual corporate return filed by 30 April

datapoints.name: Annual-return status valid
datapoints.definition: DJP response says the last two annual returns are filed

datapoints.name: Return revision share
datapoints.definition: Share of filed PPN periods with a revision

datapoints.name: Filing timeliness trend
datapoints.definition: On-time rate last 6 periods minus prior 18

datapoints.name: Tax payment on-time rate
datapoints.definition: Share of masa payments paid by the statutory deadline, 24m

datapoints.name: Tax payment index (days late, value-weighted)
datapoints.definition: Value-weighted days paid after the deadline

datapoints.name: Worst lateness, p90 days
datapoints.definition: 90th percentile of days paid after the deadline

datapoints.name: Severe lateness share
datapoints.definition: Share of payments more than 30 days late

datapoints.name: Certainly-late external payments
datapoints.definition: Billing codes created in OP after the deadline, paid elsewhere

datapoints.name: Monthly tax payment continuity
datapoints.definition: Months with a paid PPN or PPh 21 period, last 24

datapoints.name: Tax penalty notice paid
datapoints.definition: Any STP (KJS 300) or SKPKB (KJS 310/311) payment, 24m

datapoints.name: VAT underpayment frequency
datapoints.definition: Share of PPN periods with KB (underpayment) status, and paid late

datapoints.name: Tax timeliness trend
datapoints.definition: On-time rate last 6 periods minus prior 18

datapoints.name: Observed customers count
datapoints.definition: Distinct resolved observed customers, 12m to the data watermark, log, against trade-role peers
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Top-1 customer share
datapoints.definition: Largest observed customer's share of observed sales

datapoints.name: Customer concentration (HHI)
datapoints.definition: Herfindahl index of observed customer shares, 0-1 scale

datapoints.name: Customer sector diversity
datapoints.definition: Entropy of observed sales across customer KLU sections

datapoints.name: Customer regional diversity
datapoints.definition: Entropy of observed sales across customer provinces

datapoints.name: Supplier legitimacy exposure
datapoints.definition: Purchase value from suppliers that are NE/DE, CTAS non efektif, or annual-return invalid (EDOS-style)

datapoints.name: Customer legitimacy exposure
datapoints.definition: Observed sales to customers with the same bad statuses

datapoints.name: Dormant counterparty share
datapoints.definition: Value with counterparties whose own last trade is 6+ months before the window end

datapoints.name: Anchor customer share
datapoints.definition: Observed sales to customers graded large, listed or BUMN

datapoints.name: Government and BUMN customer share
datapoints.definition: Sales on VAT-collector codes 02/03
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Two-hop risk mass
datapoints.definition: Value-weighted risk of customers' customers

datapoints.name: Circular trade participation
datapoints.definition: Directed 3-cycles through the company within 90 days with similar values, normalised by degree

datapoints.name: Dual-role counterparty share
datapoints.definition: Value with counterparties that both buy from and sell to the company
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Reciprocal same-category trade
datapoints.definition: Value bought and sold in the same category with the same counterparty within 90 days

datapoints.name: Customer relationship tenure
datapoints.definition: Value-weighted median age of active customer relationships, to the last trade, with a left-censoring flag

datapoints.name: Supplier relationship tenure
datapoints.definition: Same for suppliers

datapoints.name: Top customer tenure
datapoints.definition: Tenure of the largest observed customer

datapoints.name: Top supplier tenure
datapoints.definition: Tenure of the largest supplier

datapoints.name: Long-relationship sales share
datapoints.definition: Observed sales from customers older than 2 years

datapoints.name: Recurring customer value share
datapoints.definition: Value with customers active in 2+ months of the window

datapoints.name: Recurring supplier value share
datapoints.definition: Same for suppliers

datapoints.name: Relationship stability
datapoints.definition: Value-weighted share of months active within each relationship's span, span ends at the watermark

datapoints.name: Relationship depth
datapoints.definition: Exact median invoices per counterparty

datapoints.name: Shared contact with counterparties
datapoints.definition: Phone, email or address equal to a supplier's or customer's

datapoints.name: Material recurring service fees
datapoints.definition: Service fees of 250M IDR or more, recurring, to one counterparty; revives `ref_pajaksafe_rp_service_fee` (AG6-F002)

datapoints.name: Active suppliers count
datapoints.definition: Distinct resolved suppliers, 12m to the watermark, log, against peers
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Top-1 supplier share
datapoints.definition: Largest supplier's share of purchases

datapoints.name: Supplier concentration (HHI)
datapoints.definition: Herfindahl index of supplier shares, 0-1 scale

datapoints.name: Single-source categories
datapoints.definition: Share of purchase value in categories bought from one supplier only

datapoints.name: Supplier sector diversity
datapoints.definition: Entropy of purchases across supplier KLU sections

datapoints.name: Goods/services consistency
datapoints.definition: Share of the last 3 data months' value on items or Google L2 categories seen earlier in the window

datapoints.name: Unit price stability
datapoints.definition: Weighted mean of per-item unit-price CV (qty above 1 included)

datapoints.name: Own-history price outliers
datapoints.definition: Share of priced lines above 3x or below 1/3 of the item's own median

datapoints.name: Quantity consistency
datapoints.definition: Line-weighted mean of per-item quantity CV

datapoints.name: Sales volatility
datapoints.definition: CV of monthly observed sales, no zero tail after the feed end

datapoints.name: Purchase volatility
datapoints.definition: CV of monthly purchases, no zero tail

datapoints.name: Active month share
datapoints.definition: Complete months with an approved line over months to the watermark

datapoints.name: Recency
datapoints.definition: Days from the last invoice to the side's data watermark

datapoints.name: Invoicing regularity
datapoints.definition: CV of days between invoice issue dates

datapoints.name: Ticket size vs peers
datapoints.definition: Exact median invoice value against the KLU
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Ticket size dispersion
datapoints.definition: IQR over median of invoice values
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Cancellation rate vs peers
datapoints.definition: Cancelled value over issued value, 12m, against the KLU; revives `ref_pajaksafe_cancel_ratio_over_klu` (AG3-F002)

datapoints.name: Replacement rate
datapoints.definition: Replaced (pengganti) or amended value over issued value; v0 EF-REPLACE

datapoints.name: Dilution volatility
datapoints.definition: Spread of the 2nd-highest and 2nd-lowest monthly dilution ratio, 12m

datapoints.name: Late cancellations
datapoints.definition: Share of cancelled value cancelled 30+ days after issue

datapoints.name: Dilution concentration
datapoints.definition: Share of dilution from the top 3 customers

datapoints.name: Stuck or failed invoices
datapoints.definition: Share of own invoices left in DRAFT or REQUIRE_ACTION 30+ days; v0 EF-SUCCESS, V1 HARDFAIL

datapoints.name: Late e-Faktur creation
datapoints.definition: Share of approved invoices whose faktur was created after the 15th of the next month

datapoints.categoryName: Historical payment behaviour: the company as payer
datapoints.name: Supplier-payment proxy (e-Bupot)
datapoints.definition: As withholding agent, median days from the referenced supplier invoice to the slip date (services)

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Seller-item fit
datapoints.definition: Value share of sales in categories rare (under 1%) for the seller's KLU division

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Buyer-item fit
datapoints.definition: Value share of purchases in categories rare for the buyer's KLU division

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Buyer-seller-item anomaly
datapoints.definition: Value share of lines rare for both the seller's and the buyer's industry

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Input coherence
datapoints.definition: Share of purchases in inputs expected for the KLU; missing essential inputs

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Trade-role consistency
datapoints.definition: Behaviour contradicts the role label (retail selling B2B to manufacturers)

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Resale quantity balance
datapoints.definition: Traders: quantity sold minus bought per category and unit, 6-12m; negative = selling goods never bought

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Purchase after sale
datapoints.definition: Share of resale value whose matching purchase is dated after the sale

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Capacity ratio
datapoints.definition: Turnover per employee, or against trading age, vs peers
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Peer unit-price outliers
datapoints.definition: Share of value with robust z above 3 against the category, unit and month peer median; revives `ref_pajaksafe_rp_unit_price_outlier` (AG6-F001)

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Round-number share
datapoints.definition: Share of DPP values that are multiples of 1M IDR, against peers

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Digit test
datapoints.definition: Benford first-two-digit MAD on DPP, 300+ invoices

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Duplicate invoices
datapoints.definition: Same seller, buyer and amount within 7 days

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Period-end clustering
datapoints.definition: Share of value dated in the last 3 days of month, quarter or year vs peers

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Young-counterparty large tickets
datapoints.definition: Value with counterparties first seen under 90 days ago that sit in the top ticket decile

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: VAT-structure plausibility
datapoints.definition: 3+ consecutive overpaid (LB) months with capex under 50M IDR; codes 02/03 to non-collectors; revives `ref_pajaksafe_overpay_streak_no_capex` (AG2-F001)

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Input VAT validity
datapoints.definition: Input VAT from non-PKP sellers, non-creditable categories or entertainment items; revives `ref_pajaksafe_ppn_input_invalid`

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Cross-party invoice match
datapoints.definition: Buyer's VAT-IN line has no seller VAT-OUT twin within 1,000 IDR; revives `ref_pajaksafe_ppn_strict_match` (AG2-F003)

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Fictitious-invoice signals
datapoints.definition: Vague item descriptions (under 20 characters or generic) and new-vendor tickets of 1bn IDR or more; revives `ref_pajaksafe_fictitious_score` (AG3-F003)

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Outsized invoice share
datapoints.definition: Share of invoices above the KLU p99, leave-one-out

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Period mismatch
datapoints.definition: Invoice date and tax period disagree; V1 PERIOD-MISMATCH

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: VAT-rate anomaly
datapoints.definition: VAT amount not equal to DPP x statutory rate, or zero VAT on a base-rate line; V1 VAT-RATE-ANOMALY, ZERO-VAT-ON-BASE-RATE

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Invalid invoice dates
datapoints.definition: Invoice dates outside a plausible range; V1 DQ-INVALID-DATE-RATE

datapoints.name: Offered payment term
datapoints.definition: Median days from invoice date to a real due date (defaults excluded)
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Term variation
datapoints.definition: SD of real terms across invoices and buyers

datapoints.name: Term lengthening
datapoints.definition: Median term, last 6m minus prior 6m

datapoints.name: Industry peer key
datapoints.definition: KLU (and KBLI 2025) used for peer groups and backoff

datapoints.name: Purchase-to-sale lag
datapoints.definition: Value-weighted days between buying and selling the same category
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Capex share of purchases
datapoints.definition: Purchase value in capital-goods categories
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Pricing power
datapoints.definition: Sale-category price trend minus purchase-category price trend

datapoints.name: Payroll intensity
datapoints.definition: PPh 21 gross wages over sales
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Category breadth
datapoints.definition: Distinct categories traded, finer than L1
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Item breadth
datapoints.definition: Distinct items traded, log, against trade-role peers
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Top category share
datapoints.definition: Value share of the largest category

datapoints.name: Export / zero-rated share
datapoints.definition: Share of sales on export or VAT-facility codes
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Purchase category breadth
datapoints.definition: Distinct purchase categories for core revenue, excluding assets and operating costs unless the company also sells them
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Purchase top category share
datapoints.definition: Value share of the largest purchase category for core revenue, excluding assets and operating costs unless the company also sells them

datapoints.name: Trade role
datapoints.definition: Producer, distributor, retail, service, end customer

datapoints.name: Role stability
datapoints.definition: Share of months with the modal role

datapoints.name: Goods share of value
datapoints.definition: Value on goods lines over classified value
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Resale signature
datapoints.definition: Share of sold categories that the company also buys
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Anonymous-buyer share
datapoints.definition: Share of own sales to the NO_TAX_CODE pool or individuals (B2C)
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Service share of value
datapoints.definition: Value on service lines over classified value
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Seasonal amplitude vs industry
datapoints.definition: Peak calendar-month mean over the mean of monthly means, against the KLU
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Seasonal alignment
datapoints.definition: Correlation of own monthly profile with the KLU profile

datapoints.name: Lebaran dependency
datapoints.definition: Share of annual value in the Hijri-aligned Ramadan and Lebaran window
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Year-end concentration
datapoints.definition: Q4 share of annual value against peers
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)
